author: More Perfect Union
description:
JP Morgan and Deutsche Bank’s connection to Epstein is even more damning than we thought. But you wouldn’t know it because CBS never aired Senator Ron Wyden’s interview detailing the extent of the banks’ shady dealings.

We dug into it and found that the very banks implicated wield tremendous influence over CBS, and the proposed Paramount-Skydance merger.

Producer: @snmrrw
Editor: @niklaak
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Why CBS buried this story about Jeffrey Epstein and J.P. Morgan
